title: Polylogarithmic Sparsity of Randomly Reweighted NPMLEs for Gaussian Mixtures
abstract: arXiv:2610.01088v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The nonparametric maximum likelihood estimator (NPMLE) of a Gaussian location mixture maximizes the likelihood over the infinite-dimensional space of mixing distributions. The maximizing mixing distribution can be nonunique, and the classical bound on its number of atoms grows linearly with the sample size $n$. We show that a vanishingly small random perturbation of the likelihood yields exact polylogarithmic sparsity. The resulting randomly reweighted NPMLE maximizes a weighted likelihood whose independent weights, taken to be Gamma in our analysis, concentrate around one as $n$ grows. With high probability, it is unique, has $O\{(\log n/\log\log n)^d+\log n\}$ atoms in dimension $d$, nearly maximizes the ordinary likelihood, and estimates the mixture density at a Hellinger rate that is parametric up to logarithmic factors. This sparsity holds for the estimator itself, not for an approximation of it, and requires no support penalty. T

translated_title: 高斯混合的随机重加权NPMLE的多对数稀疏性
translated_abstract: 高斯位置混合的非参数极大似然估计（NPMLE）在混合分布的无限维空间上最大化似然。最大化混合分布可能不唯一，且其原子数的经典界随样本量 $n$ 线性增长。我们证明，对似然施加一个趋于零的微小随机扰动即可产生精确的多对数稀疏性。所得的随机重加权NPMLE最大化一个加权似然，其独立权重（在我们的分析中取为Gamma分布）随 $n$ 增大而集中在1附近。以高概率，该估计量是唯一的，在维度 $d$ 下具有 $O\{(\log n/\log\log n)^d+\log n\}$ 个原子，几乎最大化普通似然，并以仅差对数因子的参数速率（Hellinger速率）估计混合密度。这种稀疏性对估计量本身成立，而非对其近似，且无需任何支撑惩罚。
tldr: 本文证明对高斯混合NPMLE施加趋于零的随机Gamma重加权扰动，即可使估计量以高概率唯一且仅含多对数数量级的原子数，同时几乎最大化原似然并达到近似参数速率的Hellinger估计精度，且无需支撑惩罚。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that a vanishing random Gamma reweighting of the likelihood yields a unique randomly reweighted NPMLE for Gaussian mixtures with polylogarithmically many atoms, which nearly maximizes the ordinary likelihood and achieves a near-parametric Hellinger rate without any support penalty.
